scope: Cold test of Understand the Assignment, Understand the Practice, and Plan the Research only.
evidence_rule: Website-supported means the permitted practice pages publish this information. It does not mean external credential checks, medical verification or current appointment availability have been completed.

findings.finding: Practice name appears as Estar MedSpa & Innovative Health Center; assignment client name remains Estar MedSpa.
findings.limits: Retain assignment identity separately from website styling.

findings.finding: Homepage lists 3300 Olney Sandy Spring Rd #140, Olney, MD 20832; telephone 301-917-3870 and email info@estarmedspa.com.
findings.limits: One listed physical location; no complete location inventory or assigned target geography established.

findings.finding: Homepage describes individualized consultation, treatment planning and follow-up with an emphasis on natural appearance.
findings.limits: Published approach, not a guarantee or independently demonstrated differentiator.

findings.finding: Estar explicitly advertises Botox lip flips and customized lip-filler treatments on separate service pages.
findings.limits: Services advertised; current stock, exact products, appointments and individual treatment suitability remain unknown.

findings.finding: Website names Dr. Mimi P. Martins as medical director/co-owner and describes her as a board-certified family medicine physician with injectable practice.
findings.limits: Do not relabel her as a dermatologist or plastic surgeon. Exact lip-treatment responsibilities and current credentials have not been independently confirmed.

findings.finding: Website names Nana Mensah as proprietor and lead aesthetic nurse practitioner, reports FNP board certification through AANP, and associates her with neurotoxins and dermal fillers.
findings.limits: General injectable association does not prove that she performs both lip services or is currently bookable.

findings.finding: Asha Rayner is listed with MSN, RN, LE.
findings.limits: No lip-injection association established. Do not treat every team member as an injector.

findings.finding: Injectables page lists Botox and Juvéderm products; Juvéderm page describes Ultra XC and Volbella XC for lip-related uses.
findings.locator: Treatment cards; What Are the Different Types of Juvederm?
findings.limits: Published product context; lip-specific approved uses and current inventory require confirmation. Other facial fillers are not assumed suitable for lips.

findings.finding: Injectables page mentions Image Pro 3D Skin Imaging Analysis.
findings.limits: No evidence it is used for lip consultations or improves lip outcomes; omit unless relevance is later established.

findings.finding: Contact page points to AestheticsPro; lip service CTAs also expose a scheduling link.
findings.limits: Link destinations observed only. Booking interface, live appointment inventory, provider selection and consultation fees were not accessed or tested.

findings.finding: Live footers exposed Facebook and Instagram URLs ending in /%20.
findings.limits: These do not establish official account handles. Social profiles were not opened.

findings.finding: Lip-flip page describes muscle relaxation without adding lip size; filler page describes volume from injectable gel.
findings.limits: Starting comparison claims only; verify mechanism and anatomical distinctions with authoritative evidence.

findings.finding: Botox overview suggests immediate early effects; dedicated lip-flip page says onset is delayed.
findings.locator: Lip flip/results sections; When Will I See a Botox Lip Flip Results?
findings.limits: Unresolved source conflict. Do not select one onset claim without further evidence.

findings.finding: Lip-flip page gives three-to-four-month persistence; lip-filler page gives six-to-12-month persistence.
findings.limits: Unverified numerical ranges; product, technique and patient variation need later investigation.

findings.finding: Lip-flip page uses comparative affordability/naturalness claims and a broad over-21 candidate statement.
findings.locator: Why Choose ...; Am I a Good Candidate ...
findings.limits: Not proof of superiority, Estar prices, a universal age rule or medical eligibility.

findings.finding: Lip-filler page uses broad safety, recovery and dissolution language.
findings.limits: Do not promise universal safety, no meaningful restrictions or guaranteed reversibility; verify limitations later.

findings.finding: Injectables overview says Xeomin adds volume.
findings.limits: Potential treatment-category error affecting the comparison; verify later, do not adopt as a medical fact.

hypothesis_review: Practice evidence supports retaining the brief's single working reader/purpose hypothesis. No assignment title or SEO label changed.
exit_assessment: Article-specific practice context and source-linked limits are recorded. This is not a full client inventory, a verified medical comparison or proof of current booking availability.
